description: Unified dataset combining all officially published NIRF rankings and parameter scores across all 17 categories.

category.description: NIRF ranking category (one of 17 official disciplines).

institution_name.description: Cleaned official name of the ranked institution.

city.description: City where the institution is located.

state.description: Standardized Indian State or Union Territory.

rank.description: Official rank as published (integer or rank band e.g. '1', '11-50').

numeric_rank.description: Integer numeric rank for exact ranks; null for rank bands.

overall_score.description: Composite NIRF score (out of 100); null where unranked or uncomputed.

tlr_score.description: Teaching, Learning and Resources score (out of 100).

rpc_score.description: Research and Professional Practice score (out of 100).

qlr_score.description: Quality of Publications and Citations score (Research Institutions).

sfc_score.description: Student and Faculty Credentials score (Research Institutions).

original_parameter_names.description: Semicolon-separated list of exact parameter names published in source.

source_url.description: Official NIRF webpage URL from which the data was scraped.

source_category.description: Exact category identifier in the source directory.

source_year.description: Exact year identifier in the source directory.

source_file.description: Relative file path of the source rankings CSV.

data_collection_date.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of data scraping/extraction.
